text.p: Jefferies & Co said on Tuesday it initiated coverage of International Telecommunication Data Systems Inc with a buy rating and a nine to 12-month price target of $26 per share.
-- Analyst Douglas Ashton said in a research note his 1997 earnings estimate was $0.56 per share and his 1998 estimate was $0.84 per share.
-- "ITDS is a leading provider of transactional billing and management information solutions, primarily to U.S. based wireless service operators," he said.
-- Ashton said the company was benefitting from the increased use of outsourced billing solutions among its target clients and an expanding target market.
-- International Telecommunication shares were trading up 1/4 at 18-1/4.
